learning_outcomes.text: Study the basics of electrical engineering: low voltage apparatus; electrical machines – DC and AC motors, converters.
Study electronic components: resistors; capacitors; diodes, transistors; thyristors, processor units, automatics units.

syllabus_topics: Basics and rules of work with electrical machines and apparatuses
Measuring basic electric quantities: voltage, amperes, watts
Check of electronic components: diodes, transistors, thyristors
assessment_rules: Attestation is given when all classes are attended. The final mark is formed from the written exam result and laboratory participation. There is an oral test if needed.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
